reason.description: Human-readable explanation of what failed and why.

request_summary.description: Echo of the original request_summary, if available.

recoverable.description: True if the caller can retry or adjust the request to recover. False if the failure requires investigation.

retry_hint.description: Optional guidance on how to recover or retry. Only present when recoverable=true.

affected_tools.description: Tools that were unavailable or failed, if relevant.
